# Everything about the event “Most Wanted” / Most Wanted (Nuka World on Tour)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_84_nukaknights-post-event-most-wanted.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

This event is one of the 4 public events that were released for free as an update for Fallout 76 with the Nuka World on Tour update on December 6th, 2022.

## Process

The event takes place in a western town setting. There are sets of houses set up there, sets of city residents and in the middle there is a carriage: the "escape wagon". The player's task in this event is to play a bandit who steals from the townspeople and then runs away in the "escape car".

First, talk to **Gunter** to start the **event**.

![](/uploads/20221014003628-1.jpg)

As soon as the game has started, the **loot items** on the city dweller backdrops as well as the safes will begin to **glow green**. Your task now is to collect as many "**Nukaroos (English: Bucharoos)**" as possible from these donors as quickly as possible. You will receive 5 buckaroos from the individual townspeople and 10-15 from the safes. **Target 600 Nukaroos in the getaway car.**

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_84_20221014082405-1.jpg)

Additionally, by destroying special liberator bots called "Gold Varmint" you can get 100 Nukaroos** as a bonus. You can also find **small Korki and Flaschi stands**, which also give a **Nukaroo bonus**.

You then have to hand in your collected Nukaroos in the escape car. When at least 600 have gathered, a timer of 3 minutes starts to defend the **escape car**.

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_84_20221014002442-1.jpg)

When the getaway car has survived the defenses, the final opponent comes: **The legendary Sheriff Bot 3* (Security Bot)**

After this has been defeated, you have successfully completed the event and you will receive your reward.

## Rewards

- 3 government bonds
-EP
- 10 bottle caps
- 5000 Nuka Cade points
- 1 of these weapons:
 - Gunter's Big Iron (Single Action Revolver)
 - Anti armor
 - 25% higher rate of fire
 - 25% less VATS action point costs
 - + Changes the ammunition type to .45
 - Western Soul (Western Spirit) (Lever Lever Rifle)
 - Raging
 - +25% damage when aiming
 - 15% faster reloading
 - + Increased ammunition capacity
- Gunter's Big Iron (Single Action Revolver)
- 1 of these plans (tradable)
 - Construction plan: Korki & Flaschi Coyboy standee

 - Blueprint: Backpack Skin (Korki) (Follower) **(not tradeable)**

 - Blueprint: Nuka-Cade poster

 - Construction plan: Nuka-Cola crate stands

## Conclusion

This event is a fun arcade-like game in between. Collect, defend something and reward
